responsibility: Declares the TyTy unification engine used at type-checking sites. UnifyRules exposes the main entry point for unifying two types with source locations, commit control, and optional diagnostics, and organizes the internal per-kind expectation handlers that implement Rust-specific structural and inference-based type matching.
same_name_distinction: Declares the UnifyRules interface and internal helper entry points that rust-unify.cc defines. Unlike the .cc file, this header only exposes the public Resolve entry point, the per-kind expect_* method signatures, and the state carried by the unifier class, serving as the type-checker-facing API.
